components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-priority interactive trigger with solid craftsman indigo tone.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #4f46e5; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4338ca; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6366f1; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Tactile white-surface secondary button with crisp border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #1c1917; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid #e7e5e4; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f5f5f4; border-color: #d6d3d1; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6366f1; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Category Filter Tab

narrative.overview:
The visual design system embodies honest, clean, and unpretentious indie-developer craftsmanship. Purpose-built for engineering hiring managers, technical founders, and collaborators, the interface rejects corporate theater, faux frosted-glass gloss, and floating gadgetry in favor of razor-sharp readability, solid paper surfaces, and straightforward technical proof.

Surfaces are anchored by warm stone paper (#fafaf9), solid crisp white cards (#ffffff), tactile 1px warm-stone borders (#e7e5e4), and high-contrast deep ink typography (#1c1917).
keyCharacteristics: Solid, opaque, paper-white cards on warm stone ground (#fafaf9)
Pure solid typography in deep ink (#1c1917) with balanced contrast (#57534e)
Grounded, inline metadata instead of floating status chips or corner tags
Tactile 1px structural borders without ambient frosted blur
Monospaced technical indicators (JetBrains Mono) paired with human geometric body copy (Plus Jakarta Sans)

rules.name: The Solid Ground Rule
rules.body: All cards, containers, and bars are 100% opaque solid surfaces (#ffffff). Frosted glassmorphism, background blurs, and translucent rgba washes are strictly forbidden.

rules.name: The Inline Metadata Rule
rules.body: Metadata (dates, categories, status, architecture) must flow naturally as inline text within the layout structure. Floating badge overlays and corner status chips pinned across thumbnails are barred.

rules.name: The Single Accent Economy
rules.body: Craftsman Indigo is strictly restricted to interactive affordances (≤8% of any viewport).

rules.name: The Pure Ink Type Rule
rules.body: All headings and display titles render exclusively in solid Deep Ink (#1c1917). Gradient text fills or clipping masks are strictly prohibited.

dos: Do use solid, 100% opaque #ffffff cards on the #fafaf9 stone canvas.
Do keep typography in crisp, solid Deep Ink (#1c1917) and Stone Muted (#57534e).
Do flow metadata inline as clean text and structured lists.
Do use JetBrains Mono for tech stacks, code tags, and metrics.
Do maintain a simple, unpretentious, fast indie-developer aesthetic.
donts: Don't use frosted glassmorphism, translucent overlays, or backdrop-blur.
Don't overlay floating status chips, pills, or badge counters on top of image thumbnails.
Don't use dark-mode obsidian planes with neon glow halos.
Don't add arbitrary proficiency ratings, percentage bars, or skill levels.
Don't use gradient text fills on headings.
